implemented: Ordinary and snow peas use native prior integer projectile X against the already mapped ground body rectangles, including zero-overlap touching edges. The source projectile rectangle is mX-15 through mX+40.
Existing regular-shot X remains an image-center coordinate. Both pea images have logical size 28x28, so native mX=Math.trunc(old model X-14). No new snapshot field or alternate asset is needed.
When integer source body positions tie, the first eligible source iteration entry wins instead of using smaller fractional X.
Regular pea/snow rendering now uses the loaded native logical texture size, 28x28, instead of forcing 19x19. Image center and loaded file/resolution are unchanged.
Fire peas, puff/spike/star/homing shots and unmapped water/special bodies retain their previous collision bridge until ported coherently.
verification: Two regressions were observed failing through actual Game.step before the fix: native edge timing and same-integer body selection.
64 edge inputs across four native body families, two orientations, two pea types, both shot directions and miss/touch controls; missed shots must hit on the next integer frame.
Controlled Scene on desktop and 390x844 viewport confirms 28x28 live projectile dimensions, one step with no hit, then one 20-damage hit and projectile removal.
remaining: Source muzzle transforms and complete shooter plant positioning are still unported; this correction maps collision to the currently drawn shot, not a claim of native emission parity.
Other projectile types, water/mini/airborne enemy bodies, boundary expiry, torchwood ordering, terrain and full update ordering still require separate source checks.
Seven current play checks and three previous-port golden snapshots fail; no seeds, strategies or golden expectations were changed in this revision.
Full desktop/mobile gameplay, physical-device CPU/GPU/RAM and 1:1 art/audio/menu acceptance remain unproven.
